audience: e-commerce merchants who ship orders through ShippingEasy

useCases.title: Review orders that changed recently
useCases.text: Search orders across all stores by last update time, status, order number or tag. Then get one order to read its recipients and line items.

useCases.title: List the orders of one store
useCases.text: List the stores with their store API keys. Then search the orders of one store by its key, with the same filters.

useCases.title: Update the status of an order
useCases.text: Find the store API key in the store list. Then set the status of one order by its external order identifier. The new status shows in ShippingEasy.

useCases.title: Cancel an order shipped elsewhere
useCases.text: Read the order by its id first. Then cancel it in ShippingEasy, so the order is not shipped from there.
